pkgmetadata.longdescription: GEPA is a framework for optimizing textual system components (AI prompts, code snippets, etc.) using LLM-based reflection and Pareto-efficient evolutionary search. The core library is dependency-free; the full/confidence/langchain USE flags enable the optional adapters and tracking backends.

use.flag: Install the practical subset of the upstream `full` extra: litellm, tqdm and cloudpickle. datasets/mlflow/wandb are not yet packaged in ::gentoo.
Enable the confidence adapter via llm-structured-confidence.
Enable the langchain adapter via langchain and langchain-core.
